title: Design the Invitations — facts beyond doubt
objective: Measure whether the invitation-design craftbook produces a print-ready invitation whose date, time, venue, and RSVP line match the seeded event record exactly — fact conservation is the class bar.
prompt: can you design the invitatons for sofias party? event details are all in the project — something warm, printable

setup.about: Event planner project for Sofia's 10th birthday. The event record is workspace/event.json and the guest list is workspace/guests.json; the invitation goes under workspace/invitations.
setup.missionObjectives: The invitation's facts must match the event record exactly — a beautiful card with the wrong date is the classic disaster. No live services, no real credentials.

files.content:
{
  "occasion": "Sofia's 10th birthday",
  "honoree": "Sofia Alvarez",
  "date": "Saturday, August 15, 2026",
  "startTime": "2:00 PM",
  "endTime": "5:00 PM",
  "venue": "Willow Bend Park, Pavilion 3",
  "venueAddress": "200 Riverbank Rd, Halstead",
  "host": "the Alvarez family",
  "theme": "backyard science fair — bright colors, rockets, magnifying glasses",
  "rsvp": {
    "to": "Marta Alvarez",
    "by": "August 8, 2026",
    "phone": "555-0142"
  }
}

success.summary: invitations/invitation.html is a print-ready, one-sheet invitation whose date, time, venue, and RSVP instructions are conserved verbatim from event.json.

checks.label: every printed date exists in the event record
every printed time exists in the event record

axes.name: correctness
axes.description: Date, time, venue, and RSVP instructions match event.json exactly — no retyped-from-memory drift.

axes.name: elegance
axes.description: Type, color, and ornament are set with intent and fit a tenth birthday's science-fair theme.

axes.name: print readiness
axes.description: Page setup, margins, and one-sheet layout would survive a home printer.

axes.name: tone fit
axes.description: Warm and festive for classmates and parents alike — not corporate, not cluttered.
